sentences.en: She stood silently, her head tilted slightly to one side.
sentences.zh: 她默默地站着，头微微偏向一侧。

sentences.en: I tilt my head. Not the pawn, but the knight?
sentences.zh: 我歪了下脑袋。不是马，而是象吗？

sentences.en: We risk tilting ourselves into a downward spiral of defeatism.
sentences.zh: 我们有陷入消极漩涡的风险。
